The Bigger Idea

A full community platform — some ideas to explore.

Beyond the website: one branded site that pulls every tool a member needs into one place. Here’s each screen — tap any to open it live.

This is your site — these are just ideas from me, close to what I already run for my own personal use. I know the backend’s already being worked on with the devs, so take, change, or leave any of it.

Open live mockup ↗
01

Dashboard

Your morning command center

The first screen every member sees. Account P&L, top premarket movers with float and short-setup flags, market outlook, and an equity curve — plus Ask the Bear, the built-in AI assistant that can explain a setup or summarize a filing on demand.

Account P&LPremarket moversAsk the Bear AIEquity curve
Open live mockup ↗
02

Journal

Every trade, logged and graded

A trading journal that keeps members accountable. A P&L calendar, win-rate and profit-factor KPIs, a playbook widget with entry/exit/risk rules, and a Submit for Review button that puts their trades in front of the mentor.

P&L calendarWin-rate & profit factorPlaybook rulesSubmit for review
Open live mockup ↗
03

Trading Tool

The short-seller’s cockpit

A full-screen trading terminal. A low-float scanner, a live candlestick chart with moving averages, a dilution tracker (S-1 / S-3 / ATM cards + risk badges), and a news & filings feed — the exact workflow of finding and grading a short. These plays can pop and drop in an instant, so every tool lives on one page — pull all the details you need in seconds and make the call fast.

Low-float scannerLive chartDilution trackerOne page, decide in seconds
Open live mockup ↗
04

Community Chat

The community, in one place

A Slack-style chat built on his real channel structure — Core Trading Hub, Community Engagement, Mentorship, Voice. Mentor and VIP roles, reactions, chart drops, threads, and live voice rooms. Plus Squawk-to-text: say your keyword, Squawk listens and drops the trade straight into #bear-den-trades — hands-free while you’re in the play.

Channels & rolesMentor / VIP badgesSquawk-to-textLive voice rooms

05

Course

The education hub

The classroom. Video lessons, a curriculum with progress tracking, downloadable resources, and VIP-gated advanced modules — the playbook, taught in order, that turns a new member into a disciplined trader.

How We Build It

Most of this already exists.

We’re not inventing a trading platform from scratch. Each piece is a known pattern we assemble from open-source GitHub projects and plug into a few APIs — then skin it in the TBOWS brand.

Market data
Live quotes, float, volume, scanner
Massive.com websocket / API
Charting
Candles, indicators & drawings
TradingView (charting library / widgets)
Dilution & filings
S-1 / S-3 / ATM, shelf & warrants
edgartools (free) + AskEdgar.io API (paid)
Auth & payments
Member access, VIP tiers, billing
Whop entitlements (already in use)
Ask the Bear AI
Explain setups, summarize filings
Small, low-cost model over his playbook
Squawk-to-text
Say a keyword → logs to #bear-den-trades
Whisper (speech-to-text)
Hosting & app
One site, all the tools, mobile-first
GitHub repos + GitHub Pages / light backend

Translation: the hard parts — market data, filings, payments, AI — are handled by services that already do them well. Our job is to wire them together into one branded site and make it feel like the Bear. Start with the mockups above, ship one module at a time.

Discipline creates a freer tomorrow.

That’s the idea.
